+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from django.test import SimpleTestCase, override_settings
+
+from desecapi import pdns
+
+
+@override_settings(POWERDNS_API="http://pdns.test/api/v1")
+class ZoneExistsTest(SimpleTestCase):
+    def _response(self, status_code, text=""):
+        return SimpleNamespace(status_code=status_code, text=text)
+
+    @patch("desecapi.pdns.requests.get")
+    def test_zone_exists_true_on_success(self, mock_get):
+        mock_get.return_value = self._response(200, '{"name": "present.example."}')
+
+        self.assertTrue(pdns.zone_exists("present.example"))
+
+    @patch("desecapi.pdns.requests.get")
+    def test_zone_exists_false_on_domain_not_found_422(self, mock_get):
+        mock_get.return_value = self._response(
+            422,
+            'PowerDNS error: Could not find domain "missing.example." in backend',
+        )
+
+        self.assertFalse(pdns.zone_exists("missing.example"))
+
+    @patch("desecapi.pdns.requests.get")
+    def test_zone_exists_false_on_other_domain_not_found_422(self, mock_get):
+        mock_get.return_value = self._response(
+            422,
+            'PowerDNS error: Could not find domain "absent.example." in backend',
+        )
+
+        self.assertFalse(pdns.zone_exists("absent.example"))
+
+    @patch("desecapi.pdns.requests.get")
+    def test_zone_exists_raises_on_unexpected_422_body(self, mock_get):
+        mock_get.return_value = self._response(422, "validation failed for supplied zone")
+
+        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
+            pdns.zone_exists("invalid.example")
+
+    @patch("desecapi.pdns.requests.get")
+    def test_zone_exists_raises_on_other_client_error(self, mock_get):
+        mock_get.return_value = self._response(403, "forbidden")
+
+        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
+            pdns.zone_exists("forbidden.example")
+
+    @patch("desecapi.pdns.requests.get")
+    def test_zone_exists_raises_on_server_error(self, mock_get):
+        mock_get.return_value = self._response(500, "upstream failure")
+
+        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
+            pdns.zone_exists("error.example")
